create_polynomial_decay_schedule: create a polynomial decay learning rate scheduler for fairseq model training
configure_scheduler_args: configure polynomial decay scheduler arguments including warmup updates, end learning rate, power, and total updates
update_lr_per_step: update the learning rate after each training step using polynomial decay schedule
warmup_learning_rate: warm up the learning rate linearly for the first N training updates before decay begins
force_anneal_lr: force anneal the learning rate at a specified epoch during training
